categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the photovoltaic (PV) industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of photovoltaic mounting systems including tracking support systems, fixed support systems, flexible support systems, and Building-Integrated Photovoltaics (BIPV) systems. It also provides intelligent operation and maintenance products such as SCADA platforms and cleaning robots for PV systems. Additionally, the company engages in EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) services for solar power projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as multi-point parallel synchronous drive for tracking systems, AI-based tracking control algorithms, wind engineering and CFD numerical wind tunnel simulations, BIM+GIS integration, and IoT sensor networks for dual-sided PV modules. It has developed advanced mechanical design software and testing systems for product reliability. Production includes vertical integration with self-manufactured components and global manufacturing bases to support rapid delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international power investment companies (owners) and EPC contractors responsible for solar power station construction. The company serves large-scale ground-mounted PV power plants globally, with significant market presence in Asia-Pacific, Europe, Latin America, Middle East, and Africa. Major end markets are utility-scale solar power projects and green building integrated PV applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with manufacturing bases in China (Jiangsu, Anhui), India, Saudi Arabia, and Brazil, and has established overseas regional headquarters and service centers in India, Middle East, Latin America, Europe, and Africa. It has projects and sales in over 40 countries and regions worldwide, including key markets such as China, India, Saudi Arabia, Spain, South Africa, Japan, Chile, Brazil, and the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the photovoltaic supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and supply of PV mounting systems and related components. It has a vertically integrated supply chain with increasing self-manufactured parts to reduce reliance on external suppliers and optimize costs. It also supports downstream EPC and power plant owners with customized system solutions and after-sales services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes innovation in 'tracking+' technologies, green electricity, and smart energy solutions. It invests heavily in R&D to develop differentiated products such as flexible tracking systems, tower-type dual-axis tracking, intelligent cleaning robots, and integrated BIPV solutions. The company is expanding its global footprint, enhancing local production capabilities, and advancing digital and AI-enabled operation and maintenance platforms to improve PV system efficiency and lifecycle management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of photovoltaic mounting systems and related products to power plant owners and EPC contractors. The company also earns income from EPC project contracts and provides value-added services including system design, installation support, and intelligent operation and maintenance solutions. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels with customized solutions tailored to client needs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in the PV tracking support system segment, ranking fifth worldwide in market share for tracking systems and the only Chinese company in the top five globally. It competes with other major international PV mounting system manufacturers and EPC service providers. Its competitive advantages include advanced proprietary technologies, global supply chain integration, strong R&D capabilities, and extensive international market penetration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 9.03 billion, representing a 41.25% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 631.5 million, an 83.03% increase. Total assets reached about RMB 9.92 billion, growing 21.53% from the previous year. The company has shown strong growth driven by expanding global PV market demand and increased overseas orders, particularly in tracking support systems.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers differentiated value through its advanced tracking support technologies that enhance PV power generation efficiency and system reliability. Its products feature innovative multi-point parallel drive, AI tracking control, and flexible designs adaptable to complex terrains and diverse application scenarios. The company provides comprehensive lifecycle solutions including intelligent cleaning robots and SCADA platforms, ensuring high customer satisfaction and strong brand loyalty globally.
